sampling: Three fresh environments per product/suite, product order alternates by round and suite. One independent trial per sleep duration/product. Compression diagnostic separate.
pilots: All /tmp/cne-results-20261106 and other pilot runs excluded from final comparison. They preceded fixture validation or used endpoint egress netem rate limiting. Final results use only /tmp/cne-final-20261106, with receiver-adjacent bridge shaping and separate TBF rate limiting.
orchestration_note: The last Herdr stream block and follow-ups initially found the shared benchmark lock busy before creating any application environment. Those launches are preserved in execution logs and resumed under one held reservation; no measured trial was excluded.
harness_notes: After the first seventeen main blocks, batch coordination was changed to reserve the lock across cases and accept a live parent reservation. The core measurement code stayed identical across all main trials.
After all measurements, the observer was updated to use namespace imports and explicit TypeScript types; measurement behavior is unchanged. Every trial retains the exact measured observer source.
